name: DCOCO: a light corrector fixes inconsistent parallel drafts in speculative decoding, up to 6.6x faster
title: DCOCO: a light corrector fixes inconsistent parallel drafts in speculative decoding, up to 6.6x faster
summary: Parallel drafting proposes several tokens at once but they do not know which earlier tokens were accepted. DCOCO scores token combinations in parallel with a small corrector, reporting up to 6.6x faster decoding than standard generation on four LLMs and 8-19% more throughput than other speculative methods.
